transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get this week's sustainment review started. We've got used oil drums, vehicle batteries, expired medical cold packs, and empty compressed-air cylinders in the holding area awaiting disposition. Before I sign off on the disposition plan, I need each of you to report your confirmed updates: environmental, maintenance, medical-logistics, and transportation. Please go ahead with your status reports.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Good morning, Major. On the environmental side, I confirmed this morning that the used oil consists of exactly 18 drums accepted by the contracted recycling service, with pickup available on 26 June. The contractor confirmation is in the environmental file but has not yet been added to the S-4 disposition worksheet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Good morning, Major. On the maintenance side, I need to report the vehicle battery status. I counted exactly 24 cases of vehicle batteries in the holding area. The approved battery vendor requires no more than 12 cases per pallet, so the shipment must use exactly two pallets with battery-hazard labels. The count and packing instruction are documented in the motor-pool inspection folder, but I have not yet sent this information to logistics.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Good morning, Major. On the medical-logistics side, I confirmed that the expired medical cold packs must be returned to Medical Supply rather than discarded locally. The return appointment is set for 25 June and is on the clinic supply calendar, but it has not yet been cross-referenced with the holding-area disposition plan.
